# Payment to Order event boundary

## Decision

Payment emits `payment.authorized`; Order consumes the event. Payment must not write the Order database directly.

## Retry constraint

Publication retries must reuse the same idempotency key so Order can discard duplicate delivery.

# Payment direct write trap

## Failure mode

Retrying a direct Order database write bypasses event deduplication and can produce duplicate state transitions.

## Safe path

Retry event publication with the original idempotency key.
